info.title: MGMD_VGS
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

filter_type.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
'filter': Group or group, source will be filtered based on multicast group membership. 'filter_additive': Includes the list of user configured forward ports, IGMP querier detected ports and PIM router detected ports in the VLAN. Multicast data packets are always forwarded. 'flood': Group or group, source will be flooded in the VLAN. 'filter_isl': Unknown multicast data packets will be forwarded to port if ISL port is configured.

forwarded_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
[Port](#/Port) entries to which traffic would be forwarded.

last_reporter.description: Host which last reported the Group.

local_receiver_detected.description: Indicates that there are receivers joined from physical ports or from static VXLAN interfaces.

mgmd_type.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
Type represents whether the entry is for IGMP or MLD.

source_count.description: Count of sources included or excluded for the Group.  An empty entry indicates a source count of 0.

source_ip.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
Source address from which multicast group traffic is requested to be included or excluded.

source_reported_ports.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
[Port](#/Port) entries applicable only for group, source entry requested explicitly to be excluded or included.

state.description: State of the VLAN,Group entry. The field MUST always be filled when an MGMD VLAN, group entry is created. For VLAN, group, source entries, static group entries, drop unknown entry, this field is not applicable and should be left empty.

version_status.description: MGMD version status for the VLAN, group. The field MUST always be filled when an MGMD VLAN, group entry is created. For VLAN, group, source entries, static group entries, drop unknown entry, this field is not applicable and should be left empty.

vgps_debug_entries.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. The VGPS_DEBUG entries is now available at [MGMD_VGPS_DEBUG](#/MGMD_VGPS_DEBUG) it can be accessed with VLAN, group, port and source as index

vgps_entries.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGPS](#/MGMD_VGPS)
The VGPS entries associated with the VGS entry. A VGS entry could have multiple [MGMD_VGPS](#/MGMD_VGPS) references depending on the number of [Port](#/Port) where reports for this VLAN, group, [source] were received.

vlan.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
[VLAN](#/VLAN) on which the group or group, source entry is created.

parameters.name: VLAN.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The ID of this VLAN. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
